span.p:
NaN root position or up-vector
SetReward(−1) → EndEpisode() · Failed = true

div.style: color: rgb(74, 10, 46) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Goal distance ≤ GOAL_RADIUS 0.5 m
AddReward(+10) → EndEpisode()

div.style: color: rgb(74, 10, 46) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Diverged root.y < −1 m OR distance > 500 m
AddReward(−1) → EndEpisode() · Failed = true
a solver blow-up reaches absurd-but-finite
coordinates long before it reaches NaN

div.style: color: rgb(74, 10, 46) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stalled stepsSinceImprovement ≥ round(20 s / Δt) = 4000
AddReward(−0.5) → EpisodeInterrupted()
truncation, not termination: the value function is
bootstrapped, so the agent is not taught the world ends
Why −0.5 and not 0: at 0, freezing beats trying-and-
falling (−1) in expectation, which trains passive brains.
Milder than −1 so trying stays the better gamble.

div.style: color: rgb(42, 16, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Deliberately absent for the four bipeds:
a biped's coded gait is a fall, so cloning it
would only teach them to face-plant faster.
Also dropped in BrokenLoco01 — BC pulls the
policy back toward the crawl being escaped

a full 3000-step episode costs 6,
under the +10 goal bonus

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: Task: potential-based progress (the load-bearing term)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(13, 61, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
delta = previousDistance − currentDistance
clamp to ±0.2 m (glitch clamp; a real step is ~0.001 m at 200 Hz)

div.style: color: rgb(13, 61, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
progress = delta × PROGRESS_SCALE 1.0
NOT step-scaled: the sum over an episode telescopes to
net metres of approach, whatever the timestep

div.style: color: rgb(13, 61, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Sensor_LimbContact
OnCollisionEnter/Exit counter per joint body
→ IsGrounded, one bit per joint

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ComputeNormalizedTorque()
Σ |jointForce[0]| / (N · 100 N·m)
applied torque, not the action — isometric
bracing must count as work

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ComputeSkateVelocity()
mean |linearVelocity.xz| over grounded joints

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
uprightDot = dot(root.up, world.up)
distance = |goal − root|.xz
actionJerk = mean |a_t − a_(t−1)|

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Physics.Raycast × 4
terrain height ahead
observation only — no reward term

div.style: color: rgb(74, 15, 13) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
NaN / Inf firewall — Reward_WormLoco.Step()
currentDistance → previousDistance · torque → 0 · uprightDot → 0 · jerk → 0 · skate → 0
then a second belt zeroes a NaN delta, because the ternary clamp passes NaN through
mlagents raises on a single NaN reward and kills the whole run

div.style: color: rgb(58, 70, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
StatsRecorder — gated on Academy.IsCommunicatorOn,
so hundreds of inference-only racers pay nothing
Reward/Progress · Reward/EfficiencyPenalty · Reward/UprightBonus
Reward/JerkPenalty · Reward/SkatePenalty · Reward/TimePenalty · Fatigue/Stamina
